Ui.Script:
-- The stock slot buttons' names (`PaperDollFrame.xml`, `Blizzard_InspectUI.xml`) for the -- body parts outside the Gear Slots, after the window's prefix and before "Slot". BENILLA_HIDDEN_GEAR_SLOTS = { "Head", "Shoulder", "Back", "Shirt", "Tabard", "Wrist", "Hands", "Waist", "Legs", "Feet", }
-- Where the art sits on the page, and how big: paperdoll.tga holds it at its top -- left, 372 by 425 of 512 by 512. BENILLA_PAPERDOLL_ART = { x = 6, y = -8, w = 372, h = 425, file = 512 }
-- Each kept button's centre on the page, on its box in the art. BENILLA_GEAR_SLOT_PLACES = { Chest = { 53, -101 }, Neck = { 330, -101 }, Trinket0 = { 53, -339 }, Trinket1 = { 53, -378 }, Finger0 = { 330, -339 }, Finger1 = { 330, -378 }, MainHand = { 147, -401 }, SecondaryHand = { 191, -401 }, Ranged = { 237, -401 }, Ammo = { 274, -401 }, }
local function BenillaGearSlots_Hide(prefix) for _, part in ipairs(BENILLA_HIDDEN_GEAR_SLOTS) do local button = getglobal(prefix .. part .. "Slot") if button then button:Hide() end end end
-- The page's stock background is its four unnamed `UI-Character-CharacterTab` textures. local function BenillaGearSlots_HideStockArt(frame) local regions = { frame:GetRegions() } for _, region in ipairs(regions) do local file = region.GetTexture and region:GetTexture() if file and string.find(string.lower(file), "ui%-character%-charactertab") then region:Hide() end end end
local function BenillaGearSlots_Dress() local art = BENILLA_PAPERDOLL_ART BenillaGearSlots_HideStockArt(PaperDollFrame) local bg = PaperDollFrame:CreateTexture("BenillaPaperDollArt", "BACKGROUND") bg:SetTexture("Interface\\Benilla\\paperdoll") bg:SetTexCoord(0, art.w / art.file, 0, art.h / art.file) bg:SetWidth(art.w) bg:SetHeight(art.h) bg:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", "PaperDollFrame", "TOPLEFT", art.x, art.y)
for part, at in pairs(BENILLA_GEAR_SLOT_PLACES) do local button = getglobal("Character" .. part .. "Slot") if button then button:ClearAllPoints() button:SetPoint("CENTER", "PaperDollFrame", "TOPLEFT", at[1], at[2]) end end
-- The model fills the art's inner panel; the stats sit over its foot, the -- resistances down its right edge. CharacterModelFrame:ClearAllPoints() CharacterModelFrame:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", "PaperDollFrame", "TOPLEFT", 80, -82) CharacterModelFrame:SetWidth(225) CharacterModelFrame:SetHeight(300) CharacterAttributesFrame:ClearAllPoints() CharacterAttributesFrame:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", "PaperDollFrame", "TOPLEFT", 77, -298) CharacterResistanceFrame:ClearAllPoints() CharacterResistanceFrame:SetPoint("TOPRIGHT", "PaperDollFrame", "TOPLEFT", 302, -84) end
-- The portrait and the close button belong to the whole window; on this page the art has -- no portrait ring and its corner sits further out, so they change only while it shows. local function BenillaGearSlots_OnPage(shown) if shown then CharacterFramePortrait:Hide() CharacterFrameCloseButton:ClearAllPoints() CharacterFrameCloseButton:SetPoint("CENTER", "CharacterFrame", "TOPLEFT", 358, -26) else CharacterFramePortrait:Show() CharacterFrameCloseButton:ClearAllPoints() CharacterFrameCloseButton:SetPoint("CENTER", "CharacterFrame", "TOPRIGHT", -44, -25) end end
if PaperDollFrame then BenillaGearSlots_Hide("Character") BenillaGearSlots_Dress() local onShow = PaperDollFrame:GetScript("OnShow") PaperDollFrame:SetScript("OnShow", function() if onShow then onShow() end BenillaGearSlots_OnPage(true) end) local onHide = PaperDollFrame:GetScript("OnHide") PaperDollFrame:SetScript("OnHide", function() if onHide then onHide() end BenillaGearSlots_OnPage(false) end) end
-- The inspect window is LoadOnDemand: hide its buttons when it loads, or now if it has. if InspectFrame then BenillaGearSlots_Hide("Inspect") end local loader = CreateFrame("Frame") loader:RegisterEvent("ADDON_LOADED") loader:SetScript("OnEvent", function() if arg1 == "Blizzard_InspectUI" then BenillaGearSlots_Hide("Inspect") end end)
